name: Kyubin Park

organizations.name: Dept. of Smart Security, Gachon University

bio: I am an undergraduate researcher at the Information Security and Privacy Lab (ISPL), Gachon University, where I study post-quantum cryptography and applied cryptography.

I also take part in a project on trustworthy agentic AI. My interest sits where provable cryptographic guarantees meet systems that people actually have to trust, and I hope to pursue that line of work at a research institute such as ETRI.
